name: 03304 · Bow, NH
findings: ZIP 03304 (Bow) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 03304 (Bow) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
